cohort: Infants admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit between 2009 and 2014
finding: Infants with CRAB VAP had higher rates of surfactant replacement therapy, cesarean section, and cephalosporin use compared to controls, and higher rates of inborn status, reintubation, and umbilical artery catheterization compared to infants with CSAB VAP.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with an increased risk of CRAB VAP compared to the control group.
gest_age: Mean gestational age: CRAB VAP 33.2 weeks, CSAB VAP 35.0 weeks, control 32.6 weeks
birth_weight: Median birthweight: CRAB VAP 1800g, CSAB VAP 2230g, control 2245g
